$comment: The plan pack's bounds, as data: its budget in characters and how many of each list it says. A pack never cuts the two calls as fill-in JSON of the level (without them a plan takes many more calls to be accepted, which costs more than their characters); files, then assumptions, then decisions are cut before them. With no area a pack of normal work is 3,014 characters when the prompt names no file (the level line, the small form, the calls line, the shapes line, the two heredoc calls) and 3,087 with three files named; a small fix is 1,091. A prompt naming no file gets the normal layout, so the budget leaves a normal pack about 1,900 characters for the area: the decisions' heading, the line of how a person replaces one (262) and the decisions themselves, because a decision that is cut is asked again.
